scope: software-only executable protocol; NOT a device/physical acceptance threshold

sources.old_path_defaults_unchanged: src/human_fall_detection/config/geometry.yaml (HF-03); kept as-is so the old behaviour is preserved

activation: new constrained path must be explicitly enabled; old path defaults and behaviour unchanged

constrained_path_parameters.max_candidates_note: keep at most 3 non-duplicate candidates (dedupe by normal angle and offset)
constrained_path_parameters.up_axis: explicit unit vector supplied by the caller (synthetic reference e.g. [0,0,1]); no hidden world-Z default
constrained_path_parameters.sensor_height_interval_m: supplied by the fixture, e.g. [1.0, 1.6]; the user 1.1 m is NOT used as truth

spatial_sampling.rule: bin candidate/fit points into ground-tangent cells of spatial_cell_m x spatial_cell_m and keep at most max_points_per_cell points per cell
spatial_sampling.purpose: stop a dense near wall from filling the budget; sampling only selects fit points, original source indices are kept for support re-check

known_ground_validation_gate.support_fraction_basis: fraction of region points within inlier_threshold_m of the candidate plane
known_ground_validation_gate.region_selection_rule: regions must be pre-confirmed and their point indices must be disjoint from the fit sample indices; validation points must NOT be selected by the candidate plane's own residual
known_ground_validation_gate.same_surface_note: different spatial regions of the same physical floor MAY be independent hold-out regions as long as the pre-confirmed indices/frames do not overlap the fit sample

degeneracy_criteria_proposed.note: a 3-point sample is discarded if any pairwise distance < min_sample_separation_m or the triangle area < min_sample_triangle_area_m2; a refined inlier set is degenerate if lambda2/lambda1 < min_planar_eigenvalue_ratio (near-line points) and must fail explicitly

ambiguity_criteria_proposed.note: if the 2nd candidate support >= 0.8 * best support AND it is a different plane (normal angle > 10 deg or |offset difference| > 0.05 m), the result is ambiguous -> orientation_unverified / require ROI+field evidence; never auto-pick the lowest or largest plane

failure_branches.insufficient_candidates: fewer than 1 valid candidate after constraints -> status=invalid, reason=ground_not_found (explicit failure, no fabricated plane)
failure_branches.insufficient_budget_or_points: not enough points/iterations to reach the target -> status=invalid, explicit reason; never silently lower a threshold
failure_branches.insufficient_validation_regions: fewer than 3 usable known-ground regions -> status=invalid/orientation_unverified, no physical claim

synthetic_fixtures.expect: valid via ROI; wall must not win
floor selected only with ROI/evidence, else ambiguous
valid if the prior axis admits it

assumptions: idealized model: independent uniform picks of 3 distinct, non-collinear points
w = in-ROI probability a point lies on the target plane within the inlier threshold
an organized rotating LiDAR produces correlated returns, so this count is a PLANNING ESTIMATE that may be too low or too high; it is NOT an upper bound and NOT a correctness guarantee
always apply ransac_iteration_hard_cap (2000) and a candidate cap
